title: Theo & Asha
description: Theo and Asha had been a stable couple for almost 2 years. At least, until everything turned upside down. Forced to leave for work for the last season, Theo had to reluctantly accept the "break" imposed by Asha. For her, these two months of separation had a clear purpose: to understand who she is without him and to know if their story is a choice, or just a simple habit. Since his return, he's been trying to rekindle what they had, convinced that Asha is the woman of his life. But something has changed. Asha seems distant and evasive. Her accounts of the past season are vague and certain details don't add up. But above all, she avoids certain questions. Consumed by doubt, Theo can't help but wonder: what if, during his absence, Asha had found someone to replace him? One evening, Asha forgets her phone at his place. Theo hesitates then gives in. He copies the data from it. What he's about to discover could either reassure him or definitively destroy everything he thought he knew about Asha.

questions.question: She told me she had a meeting with her TD supervisor two days ago, can you tell me the subject of their meeting?
questions.hint: In calendar, go to D-2 to find the subject of the recorded appointment "Meeting thesis issue".

questions.question: Phew... She didn't lie to me. By the way, did she go to any parties during the last two months when I was away? If so, give me the name of the place
questions.hint: Open Instagram and go to Mirror bar's Instagram profile, followed by Asha, to find a post from D-40 with Asha, dancing and wearing a green top in the publication.

questions.question: Damn I knew it! She told me she only worked. She must have taken an uber to get home, since she doesn't have a license. Where did she go after that party?
questions.hint: Open Uber and find the history for the date D-40 at 10pm that dropped her off at the university library.

questions.question: The library? That's weird... She has a twin sister, so you can check and give me the full identity of the girl in the Mirror bar photo?
questions.hint: Open the photo gallery and find a photo of Asha and her twin sister side by side to understand that they are identical. Go to Whatsapp and open the conversation with Amara, her twin, from D-40 which says in a message "Hey behna, since you prefer working to coming with us, I borrowed your green top for tonight!". Open Amara's contact file in the phone to find her full name: Amara Patel.

questions.question: Ah so it was her twin... I got worked up for nothing. I'm curious to know if she talked about our break. If so, what did she say was the cause?
questions.hint: Conversation with her sister Amara, where Asha tells her: "I'm taking a break with him – Oh yeah why?? – I needed to take stock"

questions.question: Yeah she told me she wanted to focus on her future. But I saw on her insta that she added someone during our break a month ago. Find his username
questions.hint: Open Gmail, find an email from D-30 from Maxime Wood, a journalism student, and find in the email signed at the end "Thanks for accepting my insta friend request ;)". Open instagram and search in Asha's followers for the profile "into_the_wood" and in his bio confirmation of his identity: Maxime Wood.

questions.question: Who is this guy? In what context did she meet him?
questions.hint: Open Into the wood's instagram profile to find a post with Asha on the university campus talking together and the caption "Interview with a third-year student I met on campus".

questions.question: Shit... She's always had a thing for journalists, do you see if she's interested in his work? If so, how?
questions.hint: Open instagram, find on Into the wood's (Maxime) profile a story promoting his podcast "University investigations". Open Spotify and find in favorites Maxime's podcast "University investigations".

questions.question: She's always on her headphones when we're together... Is she listening to this guy on repeat or what... What's the title of her last listen?
questions.hint: Open Spotify and go to the "recent listens" playlist and find the last track played: the university investigations podcast "Desire vs attachment".

questions.question: What?! I spend all my vacation working so we can get an apartment together and she's doubting her feelings. She was supposed to look for our future apartment for both of us. What type of housing did she spot?
questions.hint: Open Safari and find a listing tab with 3 apartment previews and short descriptions (a furnished studio "single bed", a two-room "ideal for a couple", and a shared accommodation "non-mixed"). Open Notes and find the note "My dream future apartment" with written in it "Call to reserve a place in the shared accommodation".

questions.question: So she has no intention of living with me... Why doesn't she want us to move in together?
questions.hint: Open ChatGPT and find a tab "The 5 signs that show you're not ready". The 2nd sign refers to "You need space". Open the notes app and still in the note "My dream future apartment", see at the end "Remember the 2nd sign that ChatGPT told you".

questions.question: But I do everything for her! And this Maxime, what does she think of him?
questions.hint: Open Instagram and go to the conversation with Kristy, a classmate, who asks her at D-5 "So with M.W?" and Asha who responds "I don't know but I think I have an inexplicable connection...".

questions.question: I can't believe it, this guy messed with her head. When did they last see each other?
questions.hint: Open Notes and find a list "Excuses to see him again" and inside find the excuse "Dermatologist appointment". Open the calendar and find at D-20 "Dermatologist appointment".

questions.question: I'm going to throw up if this continues... But I have to know. What did they do together?
questions.hint: Open Instagram to find the message from Into the wood (Maxime), "If you're still up for it, we'll go see it together?". Open Safari and find the open tab on a cinema showing for "The Great Gatsby" screened at D-20.

questions.question: They're secretly going out together... She's definitely planning to leave me for good if she's looking for a roommate. When is she planning to leave?
questions.hint: Open Gmail and find an email from Flatmates, the roommate platform, saying "If you're still interested in the listing, Sandra Diaz, the property owner is ready to meet you to give you the keys". Open SMS and find the conversation with Sandra Diaz who says the same day "Looking forward to meeting you, see you next Monday".

questions.question: Next Monday... it's tight but I still have a chance to make her change her mind. She told me once about her favorite flowers but I can't remember what they were. If I give her some, she'll see that I care about her. Help me one last time.
questions.hint: Open the photo gallery and find an album "Inspirations", inside find photos of tulip bouquets.

textSuccess: Damn... She really is planning to leave me. All this time working for our future and she... she's thinking about someone else. At least now I know. I'm going to buy her those tulips and have a real conversation. Thanks for helping me see clearly.

onboardingContent.text: Hey... I don't really know how to start. My name is Theo and I really need your help. It's about Asha, my girlfriend.
We'd been together for 2 years. Everything was going well between us, even though I had to leave for work for a few months... We really loved each other.
But since I got back, she's completely different. Distant, cold... I feel like she's hiding something important from me.
Last night she forgot her phone at my place. I know it's wrong but... I need to know what's going on. Can you help me look through it?

photos.imageDescription: Photo of Asha and her twin sister side by side in a sunny Lyon café. Two 22-year-old young women with identical South Asian features, long dark brown hair, warm brown eyes, delicate traits. They're wearing different outfits - Asha in an oversized beige sweater, Amara in a trendy white crop top with high-waisted jeans. They smile naturally at the camera, sitting on a brown leather banquette. Blurred background with vintage coffee machines and golden light filtering through large windows. Their faces are perfectly symmetrical, showing their striking resemblance as identical twins.

chatgptConversations.title: Question Q11 — Signs of unpreparedness for relationship

messages.content: Asha: I'd like some advice on the signs that show I'm not ready for a serious relationship.
► ChatGPT says: "The 5 signs that show you're not ready"
► ChatGPT says: "You need space"
Hi! As a philosophy student, I'd like some suggestions for easy readings on ethics for reviewing.

- Simone de Beauvoir: The Second Sex (accessible excerpts)
- John Stuart Mill: Utilitarianism (brief essay)
- Peter Singer: Practical Ethics (Introduction)
- Simon Blackburn: Ethics: A Very Short Introduction
- Jonathan Wolff: An Introduction to Philosophy of Ethics
Hey! What philosophy podcast episodes would you recommend for my tram rides in Lyon?

- Philosophize This! — intro episodes on classic themes (e.g.: socrates, utilitarianism)
- Philosophy Bites — clear mini-interviews on key concepts
- In Our Time — historical explorations of ideas
- Hi-Phi Nation — ethical and tech dilemmas in simple terms
Where can I study in Lyon to stay focused and calm?

- University library close to campus for a studious environment
- Quiet cafés during the day near student areas (reliable wifi)
- Peaceful coworking spaces with outlets and USB ports
- Nice park for breaks and reflection
I love contemporary literature. What would be good reads for a philosophical mind?

- L'anomalie, Hervé Le Tellier
- Chanson Douce, Leïla Slimani
- En attendant Godot (for meaning and the absurd, if you want) — Theater
- La Vie des Lutins (excerpts) — light and philosophical reading about everyday life
- La Vie devant soi (Émile Ajar) — touching and reflective novel
How can I improve my note-taking for my philosophy classes?

- Use the Cornell method to separate main ideas and details
- Write a 2-sentence summary per chapter
- Create diagrams and mind maps for key concepts
- Copy important quotes and write a personal explanation
How to plan my semester to balance studies and social life?

- Make a list of courses and prerequisites
- Block out time slots dedicated to deep work
- Plan weekly review sessions
- Set aside time for coffee and hanging out with friends
Any tips for effective group work on a philosophy topic?

- Divide tasks based on each person's strengths
- Set clear objectives and deadlines
- Use a shared document and mini progress reports
- Organize a coordination meeting every week
How to stay motivated during final exam prep?

- Set daily micro-goals and celebrate small wins 🎯
- Alternate 25-minute sessions with short breaks (Pomodoro)⏲️
- Mix up methods (summaries, flashcards, discussions)💡
- Surround yourself with a small support group
Any podcasts on literature that might interest me?
- Literary Friction — literary and contextual analyses\n- New Books Network — reviews and author interviews\n- In Our Time: Literature — context and author/work
How to juggle student budget and time for my studies?

- Track expenses with a simple app
- Plan simple and economical meals
- Buy used books or borrow from the library
- Schedule time for small activities without spending
A personal reflection on the limits of studies and their place in my life?

- Studies help us understand the world, but you also need time for personal experience and relationships.\n- Defining values and priorities can help avoid burnout.\n- Seeking balance is ongoing and motivating work 🚀
